newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 3-yr notes seen yielding 6.03/6.04 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 3-yr notes seen yielding 6.03/6.04 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $16.0 billion in three-year notes on Tuesday was expected to produce a yield between 6.03 and 6.04 percent, dealers said.
"We see it at 6.04 percent. There's some good arbitrage interest in these things where people are buying them and trading off the curve," said a trader at a primary dealership.
Traders said demand for the issue was expected to be decent.

At around 1245 EDT/1645, the three-year notes were trading with a when-issued yield of 6.035 percent. The bidding deadline is set for 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results for the auction are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
